name: vehicle speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vu=constrained carriage speed ft/s; distinct from total V

name: crosswind speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vv=perpendicular tunnel crossflow ft/s; no longitudinal wind term

name: relative-wind yaw angle
definition_status: Beauvais psi=atan(Vv/Vu), deg nose-right convention; Hucho beta=aerodynamic yaw; symbol names not transferable; Lewington PDF7Fig10 beta is aerodynamic incidence;PDF8 Eq5 beta is vehicle sideslip;local symbols must be disambiguated

name: vehicle heading angle
definition_status: Hucho p899 psi=vehicle yaw in deg; not aerodynamic beta; Nakasato Fig15 yaw=body heading relative target path, not aerodynamic incidence

name: vehicle sideslip angle
definition_status: velocity_reference_pending; Lewington PDF8 Eq5 beta_vehicle=int(a_y/v_x-r);initial/frame details pending;distinct from Fig10 aerodynamic beta

name: aerodynamic side force
definition_status: Macklin1996: CFY=Y/(0.5rhoU^2A), A frontal; positive yaw gives positive Y; source mirror-MIRA axes; Ryan1998 CY uses axialv and zero-yaw frontalA, not resultantU

name: aerodynamic yaw moment
definition_status: Beauvais CN=(CF1-CF2)d/x about0.513x aft nose; Hucho cN=N/(q_inf Ay l) aboutxs; source-specific; Macklin1996 CMz uses frontalA and wheelbase l; ground-plane reference; Ryan1998 side-area centroid, axialv, model-length l; Lewington2017 QS: ground-centerline-midwheelbase origin;WB normalization;direct CFD spline frame not proven; Nakasato p664 CG origin/Fig5 differing frames; full signed moment transform not recovered
